council_recommendation: The papers are within the stated limits: summaries are under 100 words and main entries under 14,600 characters. UK spelling is consistent; privacy boundaries and reported-versus-verified distinctions are generally clear. Cross-scope limits are respected: the 257 person-days belong only to account AI delivery, while specialist applications and shared regression have separate scopes; NFT claims remain separate. A10 adds credible local implementation evidence for AI mechanisms, not measured quality, adoption, or client outcomes. Add A10 to the index and checksum manifest. No paper reaches 4/5 on every criterion.
